brief:
Israeli forces killed at least two Palestinians and wounded four others in attacks across Gaza over the past 48 hours, the enclave's health ministry reported, according to Middle East Eye. The casualty figures came as Israeli military operations continued across the territory following months of sustained conflict.

The health ministry documented the deaths and injuries across multiple locations in Gaza, though specifics on the timing and nature of the individual strikes remained unclear from initial reports. The toll added to a mounting casualty count that has characterized the broader military campaign in the densely populated enclave.
